sam: Quick sync on the dedicated-vs-shared burst model. We need a clean, auditable protocol for requests to pre-warm GPUs and a safety model to prevent noisy-tenants from blasting warm pools. Thoughts on a lease-based approach?

kelly: Thinking in terms of "lease intents" instead of optimistic debits. Control plane asks for a lease intent (min,max,ttl,priority,pool_hint) and operator either returns a short-lived lease_token or a rejection. If token is returned, control plane commits billing. If not, control plane falls back. Keeps double-spend risk low.

omar: I like leases but we should allow a fast-path optimistic flow for low-risk customers to reduce latency. Two modes: "safe-lease" (token handshake) and "fast-path" (optimistic decrement + best-effort allocation). Canary with fast-path first, flip to leases if we see >N refunds.

tay: Important: operator must be able to indicate partial grants and a reason code. Example: LeaseGrant(token, granted_slots, pool_type, reason_code)
